mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months lowers discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 200K indicates strengthening labor demand, boosting investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 indicates weakening supply-side momentum, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals supply-side strength, reducing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 237 indicates reduced upward price pressure, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 240 triggers a risk-on reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
